jei.mbb_austenium.austeniumcraft_portal: Austeniumcraft World: a solid layered world from y -64 to y 383
Layers: bedrock at -64 / deepslate -63..-1 / stone 0..256 / netherrack 257..354 / end stone 355..383; no water and no lava anywhere
Ores are compressed per band: the Overworld band in sections, the Nether band squeezes the Nether 0..127 into 257..354, the End band squeezes the hero debris into 355..383
Dry noise caves at about half the vanilla density; Overworld hostiles spawn in all four bands, bats in the deepslate and stone bands, endermen in the end stone band

Portal: twelve tier blocks in an End portal style ring (5x5 without corners), opened by left clicking the aurelianium block; links the Overworld only, coordinates 1:1, an anchor above y 320 in the dimension returns to y 317 in the Overworld
